label: Placement Demonstration — Synthetic Security Data
notice: Telemetry, alert, and incident rows are deterministic synthetic fixtures. The 15-event count and Cowrie, profile, and evaluation aggregates reproduce a previously operator-verified controlled local lab run using invented credentials and emulated Cowrie sessions. No raw logs, real attacker identifiers, or credentials are included; this is not live monitoring.
